Hi Jordan (and Priya),

Thanks again for taking the time earlier — great to hear more about SaaSCo's roadmap and the inference critical paths. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Primary use case: real-time content personalization across web + mobile (inference for recommendation prompts)
- Peak: expected 1.8M requests/day with a regional peak window (US-EAST) of ~1,200 RPS for 3 hours/day
- Avg tokens per request: ~180 tokens; occasional long requests to 800 tokens for diagnostics
- Latency SLO: 95th <= 250ms for the personalized experience; some background async tasks can accept higher latency
- Security: SOC 2 + customer-managed key for Private/Dedicated considered

Next step: schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) with our infra SE to map throughput->GPU pools, batching, and KV cache sizing. Vivek (cc'd) will do the sizing run-through.

Could you confirm the best time windows for a 60-minute session next week? I pulled a few options and included a lightweight template (attached) that'll help us come prepared with exact QPS/token distributions.

Proposed times (PST):
- Wed 2026-03-11 09:00-10:00
- Thu 2026-03-12 11:00-12:00
- Fri 2026-03-13 08:30-09:30

If those don't work, share 2-3 times that suit your engineering team and we will send a calendar invite.

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx (fill the peak/avg numbers if you can)

Talk soon,

--

- Confirming peak: 1,200 RPS sustained for ~3 hours/day during prime time; baseline ~120 RPS otherwise
- Avg tokens/request: 180 (we see a long-tail, ~5% of requests up to 600-800 tokens for enrichment)
- Concurrency: we expect 600 concurrent active sessions during peak
- Model preference: open to Llama 3 (70B) quantized or a smaller 13B if it meets quality; want SE guidance

Hi Jordan / Priya — thanks for confirming and for the extra numbers. A couple of asks so we can make the session productive:

1) Could you populate the attached sizing template with:
   - Hourly RPS distribution (24h) or a CSV export of recent traffic by minute
   - Percentiles for request length (p50/p90/p99 tokens) if available

2) For the call agenda (60 min):
   - 10m: quick recap + constraints (security/region/retention)
   - 25m: workload patterns and sizing calculations (batching, GPUs, KV cache)
   - 15m: recommended configs & cost tradeoffs (quantization, pooling)
   - 10m: next steps (POC, pilot timeline, SLA options)

3) If SOC 2 doc is available that would be helpful — thanks for offering.

I've tentatively blocked Thu 2026-03-12 11:00-12:00 PST. I'll send a calendar invite once Jordan confirms attendee list.
